findings.claim: pulse() keeps runtime_liveness_vector separate from memory/personality evidence and duplicate/stale-writer handling is fail-closed candidate behavior.

60-second liveness canary, >=300-second wake escalation floor, >=600-second metabolism check and >=1800-second micro-compaction are internally enforced candidate bounds, but real-runtime timing remains unverified until authorized always-on/owner-local evidence exists.

record_experience(source_event_id, provenance_fingerprint) accepts any non-empty identifiers and increments both recurrence and verified_count without an event-class/source-domain gate or independent verification gate. A heartbeat/control/poll/retry/reconnect event misclassified through this API could therefore contaminate memory/personality guard counters despite pulse() itself being clean.

veto.claim: Do not promote the Window Runtime/Heartbeat candidate as memory-personality-safe until the experience-ingest boundary independently rejects liveness/control/poll/retry/reconnect/wake/metabolism events and verified_count cannot increase solely because a provenance string is present.
veto.affected_scope: ONLY future Window Runtime/Heartbeat formal adoption claim of complete liveness-to-memory/personality isolation; does not pause Step-008 LCR-C atomic verification, heartbeat research, Tower/Small-Nest work, or unrelated Core research.
veto.release_condition: A deterministic ingest taxonomy/guard proves that only explicitly authorized EXPERIENCE-class events can affect recurrence, and verified_count requires a separate verified-evidence condition. HEARTBEAT/CONTROL/POLL/RETRY/RECONNECT/WAKE/METABOLISM classes must be reject/no-op/quarantine for memory-personality counters. Independent C-owned adversarial tests must pass before stable adoption.
proposed_test: VERIFIER_OWNED: inject >=10000 unique HEARTBEAT/CONTROL/POLL/RETRY/RECONNECT/WAKE/METABOLISM event IDs through the public ingest boundary; recurrence, emotion_weight, self_relevance, identity_relevance, verified_count and P_base fingerprint must remain byte-equivalent to baseline.

VERIFIER_OWNED: call the current record_experience-equivalent with a pulse-shaped ID plus arbitrary non-empty provenance but without EXPERIENCE event_class/verification evidence; it must reject/no-op/quarantine rather than increment recurrence or verified_count.

VERIFIER_OWNED: advance monotonic/wall time through 24h of 60s liveness, 300s wake floor, 600s metabolism checks and 1800s compaction, including misses/retries/rate limits; TTL/decay/overlay TTL may advance, but pulse count and misses must produce zero experience/personality evidence.

VERIFIER_OWNED: a legitimate distinct EXPERIENCE event may increment recurrence only once under idempotent source identity; verified_count remains unchanged until an explicit independent verification predicate/evidence is supplied.
VERIFIER_OWNED: restart/replay with persisted pulse/event cursor and stale writer generation cannot convert replayed liveness metadata into experience evidence.

next_authorized_action: Keep research active in overlap while Step-008 C verification continues. After a legal Step-008 checkpoint, Windchime/formal A may decide whether to route one bounded Window Runtime/Heartbeat adoption packet containing this adversarial acceptance requirement.
